title: Rabbi Shimon ben Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 111b, saying: “Our father left us a stalk of cabbage, and we would go up and down it by a ladder.” But the Gra reads Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta, and Hyman agrees with him, for so it is in Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Ketubot 111b has Shimon ben Tachlifa’s cabbage story. The Guggenheimer digital Peah 7:3 has Shimon ben Chalafta and a mustard stalk instead. Hyman endorses the Gra’s name reading; the distinct plants and stories are not silently harmonized.
